non_idle_rule: After every result or interruption, immediately analyze, log, and launch the next experiment. The watchdog recovers only declared queued workers. When the queue is empty, the primary Codex process must plan and enqueue the next experiments. Wait only for an active process, active Codex planning, or required external operation. Stop only on exact top-level STOP.
current_hypothesis: On one shared clean sample, the seed-48/49 encoder family plus Qwen request-confidence routing improved accuracy over either seed alone with equal averaging. Measure the frozen pair on the full aggregate black-box test before further experiments. Then compare seed-48 control with seed-48/51 and seed-48/53 encoder families on a new shared clean sample. Candidate selection uses clean validation only.
experiment_queue: Run clean validation on two new deterministic 500-row samples with the frozen Qwen epoch 2 and encoder checkpoints. Compare equal averaging, entropy gating, high-confidence request/cannot routing, full request plus 50/50 cannot blending, and 75/50 class-specific blending.

Then run prepare and a fixed aggregate report for the same methods. Do not select with test labels or scores.

First complete the missing aggregate black-box measurement for the clean-selected fixed candidate set. Then replicate the class-specific blend comparison on two fresh clean samples. Candidate decisions use clean validation only.

post_queue_report_required.trigger: After the family confidence-routing validation and aggregate test pass.
post_queue_report_required.contents: Report Qwen and encoder training provenance, 500-row clean validation for averaging, entropy gating, and family request-confidence routes, and full aggregate black-box test metrics for the predeclared suite. State clearly that test metrics did not select any method.
post_queue_report_required.selection: Clean validation only; test labels and aggregate test metrics are report-only.

future_policy.continuation_metric: Clean held-out validation accuracy when validation is available.
future_policy.stop_rule: Stop at the first epoch where clean held-out validation accuracy does not improve. If validation is omitted by explicit direction, follow its fixed schedule.
future_policy.reported_metrics: Training accuracy and macro F1 from at most 500 deterministic random training examples; held-out validation accuracy and macro F1 from at most 500 examples; aggregate black-box test accuracy and macro F1 from the full test set.
future_policy.test_metrics_use: Aggregate report only, never use test labels or per-example outcomes for selection.

open_ended_phase: Explore encoder plus strongest Qwen SFT fusion first. Compare fixed blends, confidence and disagreement gating, class routes, visible-input routes, and then a regularized validation-trained stacker if fixed fusion improves validation. If no ensemble helps clean validation, return to controlled individual Qwen training changes.

evidence_audit.training_metrics_scope: Validation-only comparison. Training metrics are linked from the Qwen source checkpoint and both encoder checkpoints.

duplicate_worker_failure.reason: Shared heartbeat.tmp collision while duplicate command targeted the same output directory. No checkpoint or evaluation was saved.

stopped_experiment.reason: User requested stopping the active run and clearing the queue before continuing ensemble exploration.

queue_cleared_reason: The user requested that the active experiment and pending queue be stopped and cleared before further exploration. The queue now contains only the clean-validation ensemble screen.

failed_experiment.failure: The clean SFT source rows do not expose question/tools keys. The visible-input router now derives those features from the constructed validation input text. No official test data was loaded.

selected_ensemble_candidate.rule: Average Qwen probabilities and the fixed-weight three-encoder family probabilities with equal family weights.
selected_ensemble_candidate.selection: Highest clean validation accuracy on the current matched 500-row screen. The aggregate test result is report-only.
